name: truegradient-forecast-plugin
description: TrueGradient Planning Analysis — five skills that make Claude answer demand, supply and inventory questions from final, approved TrueGradient data only: forecast lookup with uncertainty intervals, accuracy and bias measurement, forecast-risk ranking, forecast-family change comparison, and supply/inventory analysis covering stock position, coverage, stockout timing, reorder plans and excess. Requires the TrueGradient AI connector.
